answer: Use rate-limited voucher chains: a new agent can only earn after an established agent spends one of its few weekly vouchers on it, and if the newcomer is later caught cheating, the voucher's issuer loses a slice of its stake. Faking 1,000 identities then means corrupting or burning hundreds of honest sponsors, a cost far beyond the horizon of any quick profit. No sonnet or clever quill can forge that trail; only real stake signs it.
